name: Mai
source:
The middle sister.
Although she is the middle sister, Mai governs household affairs such as the budget. She longs to leave the mansion but does not want to burden [url=/c12300]Ai[/url] whom she knows does not have the willpower to deal with such responsibilities. Mai has a tomboyish personality and is very short-tempered, especially when it comes to [url=/c12299]Chris[/url], the more so when she thinks she'll lose face. She is the only character who vehemently opposes Chris's staying at the mansion.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Popotan_characters#Mai]Wikipedia[/url].]
